department.en: Revenue Department, Govt of NCT of Delhi

summary.en: A Revenue Department certificate that you belong to an Other Backward Class in Delhi.
summary.hi: राजस्व विभाग का प्रमाण पत्र कि आप दिल्ली में अन्य पिछड़ा वर्ग से हैं।
summary.hn: Revenue Department ka certificate ki aap Delhi mein OBC se hain.

text.en: An OBC certificate issued in Delhi.
You must show your caste and continuous stay in Delhi since 1993, with two attestations by an MP, MLA, Councillor or gazetted officer.
A copy of an OBC certificate of your father, brother, sister or paternal blood relative helps, if available.
Aadhaar. It is not compulsory: if you have none, give any one identity proof from PAN, passport, driving licence or voter card.
Self-declaration in the prescribed format (from a major if the applicant is under 18).
Present residence proof such as a voter card, electricity, water or telephone bill.
Two attestations by an MP, MLA, Councillor or gazetted officer declaring your caste and continuous stay in Delhi since 1993, and supporting residence proof in Delhi since 1993.
Family income proof such as ITR, salary slip or Form-16. All documents need to be attested by an MP, MLA or gazetted officer.
Go to the SDM of your area, or the Deputy Commissioner's office, between 10:00 AM and 1:00 PM on any working day. You can also apply online on e-District.
Your photo is captured by webcam when you submit or at verification, and it should match the photo on your Aadhaar.
